jobs.description:
Sales Assistant / Sales Coordinator

Torrance, CA 90503

jobs.title: Account Opener | Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Build Relationships. Open Doors. Create Opportunities.**

Are you confident approaching business owners, starting conversations, and turning new connections into business opportunities?

**We're looking to partner with ambitious, entrepreneurial professionals who are ready to take ownership of their future, build meaningful business relationships, and create something of their own—with the support of an established company.**

Colonial Life's Southern California team is growing and we're looking for motivated, outgoing individuals who enjoy building relationships, developing new business, and taking initiative.

We value **performance, character, and potential over traditional career backgrounds.** We're seeking team players, self-starters, and emerging leaders who demonstrate integrity, a commitment to exceptional service, and a genuine desire to grow both personally and professionally.

As an **Account Opener**, your primary focus will be identifying prospective employer groups, connecting with business decision-makers and establishing new business accounts.

**This is a business-to-business prospecting and account development opportunity.** Successful candidates must be comfortable with cold calling, in-person field canvassing, industry networking and actively pursuing new business relationships.

**Who Is Colonial Life?**

Founded in 1939, Colonial Life began by offering life and accident insurance policies. In 1955, the company pioneered worksite marketing by offering employees benefits through payroll deduction.

Today, Colonial Life offers a diverse portfolio of voluntary benefits, including accident, cancer, disability, life, and dental insurance. We help employers identify opportunities to strengthen their employee benefits packages and provide financial protection for their workforce.

With more than 80 years of experience, Colonial Life fosters a culture of integrity, collaboration, innovation, and growth, supporting independent agents throughout their professional journey.

**What You'll Do**

* Identify, research, and prospect new business opportunities throughout Southern California.
* Conduct cold calling and in-person field canvassing to introduce Colonial Life to prospective employer groups.
* Visit local businesses and initiate conversations with business owners, HR professionals, and other decision-makers.
* Develop and maintain a pipeline of prospective employer accounts.
* Identify employer needs and opportunities for supplemental employee benefits.
* Schedule and conduct introductory meetings with prospective business clients.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with potential and existing business contacts.
* Utilize CRM and prospecting resources to organize leads, document conversations, and manage follow-up activities.
* Collaborate with experienced territory professionals to help secure new employer accounts.
* Coordinate with trained Benefits Specialists and Enrollers who can conduct employee benefit presentations and individual enrollment sessions after an employer account is established.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Willingness to cold call, prospect, and conduct field canvassing on a regular basis.**
* Confidence approaching businesses and initiating conversations with decision-makers.
* Professionalism and integrity in all business interactions.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
* Self-motivation, initiative, and a strong work ethic.
* Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* A positive attitude, coachability, and a willingness to learn.
* Previous experience in B2B sales, outside sales, customer relations, or business development is beneficial.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are a plus.

**Insurance Licensing Requirements**

A California Accident and Health or Sickness insurance license is required for this opportunity. Candidates who are not currently licensed must be willing to obtain the necessary license.

If you are not currently licensed, you must be prepared to complete the licensing process and personally cover the associated expenses, including:

* Required licensing examinations and examination scheduling fees.
* Fingerprinting and applicable background-check fees.
* State insurance license application fees.
* Any required licensing education or preparation expenses.

Candidates must be willing to complete the licensing requirements in a timely manner. Guidance regarding the licensing process and available training resources will be provided.

For additional information, visit the *California Department of Insurance – Individual Resident Application Procedures*.

**What This Opportunity Provides**

* **Integrity in All That We Do:** Partner with an established company committed to professionalism, ethical business practices, and helping others.
* **Dedicated Enrollment Support:** Access to trained Benefits Specialists and Enrollers who can conduct employee benefit presentations, provide individual benefit consultations, and assist with employee enrollments once an employer account is established. This allows Account Openers to focus on building employer relationships, developing new business, and opening additional accounts.
* **Company-Provided Leads & CRM Technology:** Access to prospecting leads and Colonial Life-provided CRM technology at no cost, accessible through a laptop or mobile application to manage prospects, track business activity, and conduct follow-ups while in the field.
* **Complimentary Marketing & Prospecting Materials:** Access to company-produced marketing materials, including brochures, product flyers, and business drop materials, available to order and have shipped directly to your home at zero cost.
* **Local Office Space & Territory Resources:** Access to unique Southern California Territory resources, including office space available for use

jobs.title: Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Outreach Coordinator (Part-Time, 20 Hours/Week, Afternoons & Evenings)**

Partners4Wellness (P4W) seeks a compassionate and motivated **Outreach Coordinator** to facilitate life-skills and resiliency workshops for youth involved in the juvenile justice system. This entry-level position is ideal for recent graduates who are passionate about supporting under-served youth through mentorship, skill-building, and community engagement.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Life Skills and Resiliency Workshops

* Facilitate interactive, evidence-based life-skills and resiliency workshops for youth and transitional-age youth (TAY) ages 16-25 in Juvenile Hall, the Youth Guidance Center, the Youth Leadership Academy, and other youth-serving organizations.
* Create a welcoming, respectful, strength-based, and trauma-informed group environment.
* Provide guidance, mentorship, and support to participants, helping them develop coping strategies, problem-solving skills, and goal-setting techniques.
* Build positive, professional relationships with participants while maintaining appropriate boundaries and modeling effective communication and problem-solving skills.
* Connect youth to community resources and support services that promote successful reentry.

Curriculum Support

* Maintain and update curriculum materials, participant workbooks, and community resource guides to ensure relevance and alignment with youth needs and best practices.
* Support the enhancement and occasional development of new curriculum content, workshop activities, and resource materials based on program needs.
* Stay updated on trends in youth development, trauma-informed care, and community resources.

Community Engagement and Collaboration

* Establish rapport and maintain positive relationships with Probation staff, site coordinators, and other programming partners.
* Represent P4W at community and stakeholder meetings to promote life-skills education for justice-involved youth.
* Present at conferences on promoting youth mental wellness and resilience.
* Represent P4W at community outreach and tabling events to increase awareness of programs and services.

Program Reporting & Support

* Track attendance and participation for each session, ensuring timely and accurate data entry.
* Collect youth feedback and support basic program evaluation efforts.
* Share success stories, challenges, and program updates with the Program Manager.

**Qualifications & Experience**

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Social Work, Psychology, Sociology, Public Health, Education, or a related field required.

**Experience & Skills**

* Prior experience working or volunteering with at-risk youth preferred but not required.
* Strong public speaking and group facilitation skills.
* Experience with basic data collection, tracking, and reporting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Canva.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.

**Additional Requirements**

* Work schedule consists primarily of afternoon and evening hours based on program and site needs.
* Following hire, employees will be required to successfully complete a background investigation conducted by the Probation Department to obtain and maintain access to assigned program sites.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, proof of automobile insurance, and documentation establishing identity and employment authorization are required.
* Regular travel to juvenile justice sites required; occasional travel to community locations, conferences, and outreach events as needed.
* Mileage reimbursement provided for approved work-related travel.

**Compensation: $24-$25 per hour, depending on qualifications and experience.**

**Partners4Wellness is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

Pay: $24.00 - $25.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* Please submit a cover letter with your resume.

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Weave (YC W25) is building the definitive platform for understanding and improving how engineering teams work. We believe the way engineering output is measured today is fundamentally broken and that modern AI can give teams a far more accurate and actionable view of productivity, impact and collaboration.

Trusted by 200+ customers such as Robinhood, Rho, PostHog and Browserbase, we've delivered consistent double-digit month-over-month revenue growth since May and are looking to accelerate our growth.

As Weave's Customer Success Manager, you'll own everything that happens after a customer signs. You'll get customers live fast, turn Weave into a weekly habit for their engineering managers, and make sure every account renews and grows.

We've raised a $13.5 million Series A and are backed by Standard Capital, Y Combinator, Moonfire, Burst Capital, IrregEx and the Agent Fund.

This is a rare opportunity to join at the ground floor and shape how millions of engineers and leaders understand engineering work.

**WHAT WE'RE BUILDING**
-----------------------

Weave is rethinking engineering output from first principles.

We use AI to:

* Understand how engineers actually work (not just what they ship)
* Surface meaningful insights about productivity, quality, collaboration and impact
* Help teams improve outcomes without vanity metrics or surveillance

Today that means two products: the Weave platform, which shows engineering leaders how AI is changing their team's output, quality and token spend, and the open-source Weave Router, which routes each coding-agent prompt to the right model based on cost, speed and quality.

**THE TEAM YOU'LL WORK WITH**
-----------------------------

You'll work directly with:

* Adam (CEO): leads sales and customer discovery. Adam is a former sales executive at multiple high-growth startups who has scaled multiple sales teams from $0 to $30M in ARR, and he stays deeply embedded with customers.
* Andrew (CTO): previously a founding engineer at Causal, MIT alum. Andrew is deeply committed to mentorship and ownership for everyone on the team, and will be your closest partner on getting more technical fast.

You'll also work side by side with our sales team and engineers every day.

This is a small, intense, highly collaborative team. You will have real ownership from day one.

**THE ROLE**
------------

This isn't a traditional customer success role. You'll be as comfortable debugging an integration as you are running a renewal call. The closest thing we can describe it as is a mashup of account manager, solutions engineer and data analyst.

Every customer buys Weave to answer some version of the same question: "is AI actually making our engineering team better, and is it worth what we're spending?" Your job is to make sure they get an answer they trust, and then act on it.

You'll own a book of our largest accounts from kickoff to renewal, from fast-growing startups to public companies like Robinhood. You'll also build the onboarding and automation that covers every other customer. You'll be measured on whether customers stay, whether usage spreads from the leader who bought Weave to the managers who run their teams with it every week, and whether accounts grow.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
--------------------

* **Get customers live fast.** Run onboarding end to end, from connecting GitHub and AI tools like Claude Code and Cursor to their first executive report.
* **Drive adoption past the buyer.** Train engineering managers and tech leads until Weave is part of their 1:1s, sprint reviews and planning.
* **Be the expert on the data.** Help customers read their metrics, run business reviews on what changed, and dig in when a number looks wrong.
* **Own renewals and expansion.** Track account health, find the next champion when one leaves, and partner with sales to grow accounts.
* **Close the loop with engineering.** Triage and reproduce issues, write bug reports engineers can act on, and bring customer patterns back to the roadmap.
* **Build the playbook.** Onboarding checklists, health scores and help docs, automated wherever possible.

**QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------

### **MUST-HAVE**

* 2+ years in a post-sale, customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS company: customer success, account management, implementation, solutions or support.
* You've owned a book of business. You were measured on renewals, retention or expansion, and you can walk us through your numbers and the accounts you saved.
* You're technical enough to unblock customers. You don't need to have been an engineer, but you know how software teams ship (PRs, code review, CI/CD, incidents), you're at home in GitHub, and when an integration breaks, you dig in before you escalate.
* You use AI tools every day. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or similar are part of how you work, and you have real opinions about what they're good at.
* You write and speak clearly. You can walk a CTO through a messy dataset in a few minutes, and write the follow-up that gets everyone aligned.
* Self-starter who's comfortable in ambiguity and wired for speed.
* This role is 5 days in office in SF

### **NICE-TO-HAVE**

* Hands-on technical experience. You've worked as a software engineer, support engineer, solutions engineer or forward deployed engineer, or you've shipped code as part of your job.
* You can write SQL or a quick Python script to answer your own questions.
* Customer success experience at a developer tools, data or AI company where your users were engineers
* Real opinions on DORA, SPACE and DevEx, and on what changes when agents write half the code
* You've built customer success from zero: onboarding programs, health scores, QBR templates, help docs
* Experience at an early-stage startup (Seed to Series B)

**WHY JOIN**
------------

* $120K-$150K base salary + early equity
* Health/vision/dental insurance covered
* Free lunch/dinners/snacks
* Yearly team offsite with regular team events
* Yearly $500 learning/develo

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
We're hiring Sales Development Representatives to be the critical first impression of our company and offering, turning prospect attention into qualified pipeline across the United States and Canada. You'll partner closely with our Sales Leadership, Marketing and Atheer’s executive team to perform both outbound prospecting and qualify inbound leads for Atheer’s high-value accounts, resulting in quality booked meetings that our Account Executives run and close.

Atheer's buyers are technical, sophisticated operators - senior leaders who keep drilling rigs, vehicles and production lines running, critical drugs and devices manufactured, and other critical industrial operations. They respond to substance, not fluff. Your job is to earn their attention with sharp, credible, well-honed messaging to set up qualified, meaningful conversations worth having.

**Responsibilities & Key Role Objectives**

* Quickly understand Atheer’s value add and our ideal customer profile across multiple industries such that you can hold credible conversations with leaders in operations, quality, or compliance
* Build target account lists using AI, business directories, following leads from existing clients and distribution partners, and attending trade shows and conferences
* Strategize, prepare, call upon, manage and measure against target account lists in conjunction with your lead Account Executive(s) following SDR outbound best practices
* Identify and multi-thread the decision makers and influencers inside target accounts, and find the sharpest way to reach them
* Run targeted outbound using research-led, hypothesis-driven personalization rather than generic sequences across calls, emails, social and other channels
* Qualify inbound and outbound leads quickly and honestly against our qualification criteria

jobs.title: Italian Food Procurement Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Varuni Napoli is seeking an organized and detail-oriented Italian Food Procurement Coordinator to support the purchasing and sourcing of food ingredients, kitchen supplies, and restaurant essentials. This role focuses on coordinating supplier orders, monitoring inventory requirements, maintaining purchasing records, and helping ensure that high-quality ingredients are available to support daily restaurant operations.

The ideal candidate has strong communication and organizational skills, an understanding of food procurement processes, and an interest in Italian cuisine and restaurant supply management.

Common Job Roles

* Italian Food Procurement Coordinator
* Restaurant Purchasing Coordinator
* Food Sourcing Associate
* Culinary Supply Coordinator
* Procurement Operations Specialist
* Restaurant Inventory Coordinator

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate purchasing activities for food ingredients, beverages, packaging, and kitchen supplies.
* Communicate with approved suppliers regarding pricing, product availability, and delivery schedules.
* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate replenishment based on restaurant requirements.
* Assist with sourcing fresh produce, cheeses, flour, pasta ingredients, sauces, and other Italian food essentials.
* Review purchase requests and help prepare and track purchase orders.
* Maintain accurate records of supplier information, purchasing transactions, and deliveries.
* Verify incoming shipments against purchase orders and report discrepancies.
* Work with kitchen managers to understand ingredient specifications and quality expectations.
* Help compare supplier quotations and identify opportunities for cost-effective purchasing.
* Track delivery delays, shortages, and product substitutions, escalating issues when necessary.
* Support appropriate storage and inventory rotation for perishable and nonperishable products.
* Follow company purchasing procedures and applicable food safety requirements.

Qualifications and Requirements

* Previous experience in procurement, purchasing, inventory management, logistics, or restaurant operations is preferred.
* Knowledge of food ingredients and restaurant supply requirements.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Effective communication and supplier coordination abilities.
* Familiarity with purchase orders, inventory records, and basic cost tracking.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets and standard office software.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and meet purchasing deadlines.
* Problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with kitchen and management teams.
* Familiarity with Italian cuisine or specialty food sourcing is an advantage.

Preferred Skills

* Food procurement and supplier coordination
* Ingredient sourcing and quality awareness
* Inventory monitoring and replenishment
* Purchase order management
* Cost comparison and recordkeeping
* Delivery scheduling and logistics coordination
* Food storage and inventory rotation
* Time management and teamwork

Work Environment

This position supports restaurant purchasing and inventory operations. The coordinator may work in an office or restaurant setting and communicate regularly with suppliers, kitchen staff, restaurant managers, and delivery personnel. The role requires careful recordkeeping, timely follow-up, and attention to ingredient quality and availability.

Career Progression

With experience and strong performance, this role may lead to opportunities such as Senior Procurement Coordinator, Food Purchasing Specialist, Supply Chain Supervisor, Procurement Manager, or Restaurant Operations Manager.

About the Company

Varuni Napoli is an Atlanta-based Italian restaurant known for its Neapolitan-style pizza and Italian-inspired menu. Effective procurement coordination helps support ingredient quality, reliable supply availability, and smooth restaurant operations.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a résumé highlighting relevant experience in food purchasing, supplier communication, inventory management, procurement, or restaurant operations. Experience with fresh ingredients, specialty food products, and purchase order systems should be included where applicable.

**Note:** This is a sample Indeed-style job post based on the company name and job title provided. It does not confirm that Varuni Napoli currently has this specific position available.

Pay: $20.00 - $23.00 per year

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Bilingual Digital Marketing Manager (Spanish)— Relocation to Indiana
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Amador Jewelers is a growing fine jewelry company based in Lafayette, Indiana, specializing in 14K gold through wholesale and retail operations. The team values ownership, clear communication, adaptability, and customer focus.

**Build content that connects with our customers**

Amador Jewelers is looking for a hands-on Marketing Manager to organize our day-to-day marketing work, create engaging content, and help develop our Marketing Associate. You will report to our Director of Marketing and work with company leadership to turn ideas into coordinated campaigns, videos, and social media content.

This role combines creative production with daily team coordination. You should be comfortable editing a long-form video, reviewing a content calendar, coaching a teammate, and explaining what the data suggests we should try next. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of assigned projects, communicate early, and keep work moving.

**What you will do**

* **Own the daily workflow.** Translate marketing priorities into clear tasks, timelines, and deliverables. Maintain campaign and production calendars, identify dependencies, and raise scheduling conflicts before deadlines are affected.
* **Coordinate production.** Prepare creative briefs, storyboards, and shoot plans. Coordinate participants, materials, and filming schedules across departments. Support video shoots and live productions.
* **Create and edit content.** Take the lead on long-form editing for YouTube, interviews, and podcasts. Support short-form videos and develop graphics, thumbnails, and campaign materials.
* **Manage the content pipeline.** Oversee the Marketing Associate’s scheduling work and maintain accurate content records, including versions, transcripts, approval status, and publishing destinations.
* **Review quality and coordinate approvals.** Check visuals, audio, captions, subtitles, calls to action, and formatting. Track revisions and ensure the approved version is the one scheduled for publication.
* **Oversee social media execution.** Verify that scheduled content publishes correctly across assigned channels, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Address publishing issues and coordinate follow-up.
* **Turn insights into action.** Review content performance, audience retention, engagement, and campaign findings. Recommend specific creative changes and tests based on what you observe.
* **Support paid campaigns.** Work with the Director of Marketing on ad creative, campaign reviews, and testing, within approved budgets and authorization.
* **Coach and communicate.** Guide the Marketing Associate, provide practical feedback, and participate in daily team check-ins. Share concise updates on completed work, open items, blockers, and next steps.

**What you bring**

* Demonstrated experience executing and coordinating content marketing across multiple social media platforms.
* A portfolio showing short-form and long-form video editing, graphic design, and content adapted for different channels and audiences.
* The ability to organize production schedules, manage several deliverables, and follow through without constant task-by-task direction.
* Experience guiding a teammate or coordinating the work of other contributors, with a practical and supportive approach to feedback.
* The ability to interpret content metrics and explain actionable recommendations in straightforward terms.
* An understanding of Hispanic audiences in the United States and an interest in learning about Amador’s customers.
* Familiarity with AI tools that support content creation and workflow, along with the judgment to review accuracy and quality before using their output.
* Strong attention to detail, clear communication, and a willingness to take ownership of both creative work and operational follow-through.

**Experience we would value**

* Meta Ads, paid social creative testing, or campaign performance reviews.
* Live production, livestream support, or podcast production.
* Project management, website content updates, or content management systems.
* Jewelry, retail, wholesale, or other customer-facing businesses.

**How you will work**

You will work on-site in Lafayette, Indiana, alongside our Marketing Associate, with direction and ongoing feedback from our Director of Marketing. The planned daily schedule is 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., including a one-hour lunch. Weekly workdays will be discussed during the interview process.

You will have regular check-ins and reviews at 30, 60, and 90 days. Early expectations will focus on learning our brand and processes, keeping calendars and reports accurate, delivering assigned work, and communicating obstacles. As you become established, we will define production and performance goals together.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with your resume and a portfolio link. Include examples of both short-form and long-form video, along with graphic design or campaign work. For each example, briefly explain your role in creating it. In your application, please share one example of a project you managed from planning through publication, and confirm your availability to work on-site in Lafayette, Indiana.

Pay: $53,000.00 - $58,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
